title: wiretap: add more to <wsutil/pint.h> and use it for everything.
description:
Add additional routines for one-byte items (for completeness) and
non-power-of-2 items.

Remove the similar definitions from wiretap/wtap-int.h, remove the
include of <wsutil/pint.h> from wiretap/wtap-int.h, and have routines
that use the stuff from wsutil/pint.h include it themselves.

In the process, handle 40-bit time stampes in the EyeSDN file read/write
code, unsignedify some values, and note why we use %d and unsigned
values in sscanf.
